title: Door contract docs misstate a fresh stepped-down boot's handle fields
body:
The start route's documented `model` row says the handle's model is "for a fresh boot, this field", and the `harness` row beside it says "the handle's `harness` names it back" — both written before the rung's step-down (tick 6fv). A rung dispatch with no free subscription is re-resolved by the factory onto the deployment's standing pair before the container is addressed, so the handle a fresh STEP-DOWN boot mints names the re-resolved pair, never the request's fields. A future implementer reading the table would expect the echo and could 'fix' the truthful answer, or build a client check on the wrong invariant.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-dispatch.ts:70 (the model row; the harness row at :71)
